Resolves #21498

The rename-in-place component arms wait for the editor's whole text to be selected before their first key. Under CI load the keys reached the page ahead of the worker's queued selection. AC-4 then typed "notes.txt" onto "a.txt" (run `44576392493` on #21491), and AC-3's single Backspace had the same race. Only the spec changes.

Evidence: L2 (component spec in CI; the race reproduced and cleared outside CI) → L2 required (AC-1..AC-3). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `test/playwright/component/list/ItemEditing.spec.mjs`: `editorReady()` runs before the first editing key in all six arms that edit a name |
| AC-2 | Outside-CI: with `Neo.main.DomAccess.selectNode` delayed 300 ms in the page, `dev`'s spec fails 4 of 7 and this one passes 7 of 7 |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: the components tier on this PR |

## Deltas from ticket

None substantive.

## Test Evidence

The reproduction delays `selectNode` 300 ms through an init script in two throwaway copies of the spec, `dev`'s and this one. Neither copy is committed. A 20× CPU throttle alone did not reproduce it, because the keys still run before the queued message. Without the delay the fixed spec passes 35 of 35 (5 repeats, 4 workers).

## Post-Merge Validation

None.

Intake: self-authored this session. Prescription checked: the spec owns the wait. The plugin's focus-then-select order stays as it is; the ticket's Out of Scope records why.
